appName.message: Credit Card Generator: Test Card Numbers
appName.description: Extension name shown in Chrome and on the Web Store listing. Max 45 characters.

appDesc.message: Generate Luhn-valid test credit card numbers, validate a BIN and autofill checkout forms. Dummy card data for developers and QA.

cmdFillDesc.message: Fill the payment form on this page with a test card

menuFill.message: Fill this payment form with a test card

menuInsert.message: Insert a test card number here

menuCopy.message: Copy a test card to the clipboard

validateEmpty.message: Type or paste a card number. Spaces and dashes are ignored.

validateFineprint.message: Format only: Luhn check digit, network prefix and length. Nothing here can tell you whether a card exists, is active, or has funds. The number stays on this machine.

resultLengthOutOfRange.message: $1 digits — outside the 12–19 range ISO/IEC 7812 allows

resultUnknownPrefix.message: unrecognised prefix — not one of the published ranges

resultCheckDigitShouldBe.message: Check digit should be $1, got $2 — usually a mistyped digit

linkFullTable.message: Full table, decline codes and 3-D Secure cards →

toastNoFieldsBody.message: Hosted card iframes (Stripe Elements, Braintree hosted fields) cannot be filled — copy the number instead.

toastNoField.message: Right-click inside a text field first

toastPasteManually.message: Paste into the field with Ctrl+V / ⌘V

toastNotANumber.message: That selection is not a card number

optAutoGenerate.message: Generate a card as soon as the popup opens

optShortcutHint.message: Keyboard shortcuts — Alt+Shift+C opens the popup, Alt+Shift+F fills the form on the current page. Change them at chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

disclaimer.message: Dummy, Luhn-valid test values for software testing only. These are not real cards and cannot be used for payments.
